headline: Committee approves $40,000 for environmental grants and $500,000 sewer borrowing cut

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Move $500,000 from the sewer fund category B to reduce bonding for a wastewater pump station project
meeting.summary: A motion adding $40,000 to environmental protection grants, with up to $40,000 for Haʻikū Community Association stream testing, carried. The sewer motion on bond borrowing for a wastewater pump station project passed with eight ayes, one member excused.
meeting.recap: A member moved to add $40,000 to environmental protection grants.[[0:12:55]] Up to $40,000 would go to the Haʻikū Community Association for its stream testing program.[[0:13:21]] The motion carried.[[0:14:18]] The motion passed with eight ayes and one member excused.[[0:19:02]] Tamara Paltin moved to set aside up to $250,000 in grants for a community group.[[0:20:19]] The motion was withdrawn, with plans to move the grant to a different office's budget.[[0:22:31]] Tamara Paltin proposed cutting $22,108 tied to a grant specialist job that is not yet created.[[0:23:41]] The proposal was withdrawn.[[0:24:58]] A member moved to cut $500,000 from the sewer budget for a sewer project.[[0:27:54]] A member asked why savings keep carrying over while sewer rates rise 9% every year.[[0:40:00]] The final motion used the $500,000 to reduce bond borrowing for a wastewater pump station project.[[0:43:29]] The motion passed with eight ayes and one member excused.[[0:44:28]]
decided: The motion to use $500,000 in sewer money to reduce bond borrowing for a pump station project passed.
meeting.next: The white papers on the cloud bridge proposal will be submitted so every member has a copy. A member said a transfer to the capital reserve fund could be worked on through legislation in the future. The committee will pick up its budget review after lunch.

moments.q: "Why are we carrying over all these savings and still getting 9% sewer rate increases every year?"
